purpose: Fixed fresh Claude CLI sessions per author, critic and revision; continuation of preserved same-essay lineage.
source_policy: Separate public HTTPS raw retrieval and text extraction triggered by WebFetch; exact source files passed only to same-essay dependents. Native bound PDF reads preserved. Failed access remains explicit.
privacy: Ordinary local paths allowed by current user. Unrelated chats, biography, relationships, preferences and credentials excluded. Narrow relay marker screen is not semantic anonymization certification.
configuration: Requested model, effort and fixed-session orchestration plus separate native observations. Ultracode is off; no child agents allowed.
acceptance: Required artifacts, JSON/source schema, source integrity, requested versus observed model/effort, manuscript ceiling, immutable input binding. Not philosophical acceptance.
archive_policy: Durable visible journal and content-addressed artifact versions, selected tool argument metadata and native configuration observations before dependency launch. Canonical intake after finite run exits.
exclusions: Hidden reasoning, internal instructions, whole native transcripts and full unreviewed tool results. Provider-reported token usage/estimated cost is not a billing attestation.
stop: Persistent stop latch blocks subsequent stages; explicit resume-stopped required. No quota scheduler or automatic retry.
